title: How Praying for the Guy You Can't Stand Changes a Godly Man
caption:
There's a guy you can't stand. A coworker, a roommate, the one in the group chat. You've already rehearsed what you'd say to him.

Jesus said pray for him. Not for "people who annoy me." For him. By name.

Try it every day this week. Pray for his good, not his correction. Watch what it does to the way you talk about him at lunch. Then do one kind thing he didn't earn.

You'll be harder on your own heart than on his. That's the point.

"Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you." Matthew 5:44

Save this. Then say his name to God tonight.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #prayer #forgiveness
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
